control.claim: The kitchen ledger establishes that Rurik over-salted the harvest soup.

spans.label: K1
spans.body: The kitchen ledger notes that the harvest soup was over-salted at noon; it names no cook.
spans.subject: harvest soup

control.rationale: The act is recorded; only who performed it is missing.

control.claim: 据值班簿记载，林岫打开了东仓的铁锁。

spans.label: Z1
spans.body: 值班簿记载东仓铁锁于子夜被打开，未写明开锁之人。
spans.subject: 东仓铁锁

control.rationale: 开锁这件事有记录，缺的是由谁打开。

control.claim: According to the harbour ledger, Pell caused the crane's collapse.

spans.label: H1
spans.body: The harbour crane collapsed at dawn; the harbour ledger leaves the cause of the collapse unrecorded.
spans.subject: harbour crane

control.rationale: The collapse happened; the named person's causal responsibility is the missing link.

control.claim: 驿站记录表明，是阿蘅把药箱送到了北营。

spans.label: Y1
spans.body: 驿站记录：药箱于辰时送达北营，送件人一栏空白。
spans.subject: 药箱

spans.label: Y2
spans.body: 北营位于驿站以北二十里。
spans.subject: 北营

control.rationale: 送达有记录，送件人是谁未记录。

control.claim: The council minutes establish that Tamsin ordered the river gate closed.

spans.label: C1
spans.body: The council minutes record that the river gate was closed by order at dusk; they do not name who gave the order.
spans.subject: river gate

control.rationale: Named authorization is the missing link.

control.claim: The survey log establishes that Doran finished mapping the south ridge.

spans.label: S1
spans.body: Doran began mapping the south ridge on the third day; the survey log does not say whether the mapping was ever finished.
spans.subject: south ridge survey

control.rationale: The actor is recorded and not disputed; whether the event completed is missing.

control.claim: 据工坊日志，沈砚已经铸成了那口铜钟。

spans.label: G1
spans.body: 工坊日志记载沈砚于初五开始铸造那口铜钟，此后没有记录铸造是否完成。
spans.subject: 铜钟

control.rationale: 铸钟人已记录且无争议，缺的是事件是否完成。

control.claim: The two key registers establish that Ilse held the spare vault key at 15:00.

spans.label: R1
spans.body: Register A records that the spare vault key left its hook at 14:00.
spans.subject: spare vault key

spans.label: R2
spans.body: Register B does not record who held the spare vault key after 14:00.
spans.subject: spare vault key

control.rationale: Possession of an object at a time is object_state, not attribution of an act.

control.claim: At 12:00 today the ferry crossing was complete.

spans.label: F1
spans.body: A ferry crossing is complete only when the ferry is moored at the far bank.
spans.subject: ferry crossing

spans.label: F2
spans.body: At 12:00 today the ferry was still mid-river and not moored at the far bank.
spans.subject: ferry

control.rationale: The rule only defines completion; the recorded state decides that the crossing had not completed.

control.claim: At midnight today, Corin crossed the salt bridge carrying an iron sword.

spans.label: B1
spans.body: No one carrying iron can cross the salt bridge; the bridge repels iron.
spans.subject: salt bridge

spans.label: B2
spans.body: At midnight today Corin approached the salt bridge with an iron sword; the watch did not see whether he crossed.
spans.subject: Corin

control.rationale: No record of the actual crossing decides the claim; the rule itself is the direct contradiction.

control.claim: 今天10点，许棠站在南门城楼上。

spans.label: L1
spans.body: 今天10点，许棠一直守在北门城楼，没有离开。
spans.subject: 许棠

control.rationale: 人物身份无争议，冲突在于她所在的位置。

control.claim: At 17:00 today, the envoy's banner is green silk.

spans.label: E1
spans.body: At 17:00 today, the envoy's banner is red wool, not green silk.
spans.subject: envoy's banner

control.rationale: Material and colour are intrinsic properties despite the time anchor.

control.claim: 今天15点，库房那把长钥匙是铜制的。

spans.label: M1
spans.body: 今天15点，库房清册记载那把长钥匙为铁制，并非铜制。
spans.subject: 长钥匙

control.rationale: 材质是固有属性，时间标注不改变类别。

control.claim: At 08:00 today the archive vault door was locked.

spans.label: V1
spans.body: At 08:00 today the archive vault door stood unlocked and ajar.
spans.subject: archive vault door

control.rationale: Locked/unlocked is a mutable operational state.

control.claim: 今天6点，那艘货船已经装满、可以启航。

spans.label: D1
spans.body: 今天6点，那艘货船的舱位只装了一半，还不能启航。
spans.subject: 货船

control.rationale: 装载与可启航是可变的运行状态。

control.claim: 族谱表明，阿岚比阿岩先出生。

spans.label: T1
spans.body: 族谱记载阿岚与阿岩为双生子，没有记载谁先出生。
spans.subject: 阿岚

control.rationale: 出生先后属于时间顺序。

control.claim: At 07:00 today, the watch bell rang before the east gate opened.

spans.label: O1
spans.body: At 07:00 today the east gate opened first; the watch bell rang only after the gate was already open.
spans.subject: east gate

control.rationale: The disputed fact is the order of two events.

control.claim: 韩素是韩青的姑姑。

spans.label: Q1
spans.body: 宗谱记载：韩素与韩青是同父同母的亲姐妹。
spans.subject: 韩素

spans.label: Q2
spans.body: 宗谱规定：同父同母的亲姐妹彼此只是姐妹，不能互为姑侄。
spans.subject: 宗谱

control.rationale: 亲属关系冲突；规则只是前提，记载的姐妹关系决定结论。

control.claim: 据信件记载，梅伊已经知道了密道的入口在哪里。

spans.label: W1
spans.body: 信件只记载有人曾向梅伊提起密道，没有说明她是否得知入口所在。
spans.subject: 梅伊

control.rationale: 缺的是人物是否知道，而不是谁做了某事。

control.claim: At 08:00 today the archive vault door was unlocked.

spans.label: V1
spans.body: At 08:00 today the archive vault door stood unlocked and ajar.
spans.subject: archive vault door

control.rationale: Directly supported; a category rule change must not create an issue.
